st_remedes.name: Allée des Ballons · Balloon Lane
st_remedes.alt: A sunny summer herb garden with sandy paths, pots of lavender and herbs, pink rose hedges and balloons tied to the fence posts. On the left stands a wooden herb-drying shed with bundles of herbs and a blue door under a red-and-white striped awning; in the middle a green arched door in the old stone wall; on the right an iron gate under an arch of roses. Monsieur Verbe kneels to fasten a silver buckle on his shoe; coughs into his elbow so hard his beret and toupee pop up; hauls on a rope to raise a tall striped flag; carries a tray of lemonades with a fly on his nose, hand mirror in hand; blows up a huge red balloon; and squeezes a giant sponge beside an empty bucket. The gap in the rose hedge on the far left leads back to the Quartier de la Santé.

accrocs.name: Rue des Accrocs · Snag Street
accrocs.alt: The sunny back corner of the herb garden behind the drying shed, with a white picket fence, a lettuce patch, a picnic table under a big shady tree and a grassy slope. Monsieur Verbe, in a green beret, holds up his baggy trousers and a tiny salad; cups his hands round a flickering candle; tears his trouser leg on the picket fence; hands his sandwich to a hungry little dog; stares at the bee that has dented his cake; and strains to push a cart of giant pencils up the slope. The shed's old wooden door on the left leads back to the herb garden.

doors.label: Allée des Ballons
doors.hint: Back through the old wooden door

soulagement.name: Rue du Soulagement · Relief Street
soulagement.alt: A peaceful cottage courtyard behind the stone wall, with herb beds, a pumpkin patch and a hammock between two trees. Monsieur Verbe, in a green beret, sits on a stool for a check-up beside a smiling doctor in a white coat with a stethoscope; lifts a heavy sack off a tired donkey; lazes in the hammock; in a gold beret, shows off his cactus beside an empty watering can; and trips over a big pumpkin. The green arched door on the left leads back to the herb garden.

doors.label: Allée des Ballons
doors.hint: Back through the green arched door

renaissance.name: Place de la Renaissance · Rebirth Square
renaissance.alt: A walled rose garden in bloom with a round stone fountain and pink blossom trees. Monsieur Verbe, in a gold beret, faints onto a red cushion beside a toy van full of tiny spiders, his hand mirror slipping; sits sadly by a melting snowman; in a green beret, bandages a rocking horse's leg; in a gold beret, cheers as a golden phoenix rises from a stone bowl; unties a huge knot of rope; and, older, with a medal and a gold beret, smiles over his photo album on a bench. The iron gate under the roses on the left leads back to the herb garden.

doors.label: Allée des Ballons
doors.hint: Back through the rose-arch garden gate
